resumo: Three questions, always the same ones, every birthday. Record the audio. In ten years you will have a priceless collection.

secoes.texto: A short video, on her birthday, with the same five or six questions. On its own it is nothing much. Fifteen years later, with all of them in a row, it is probably the most valuable thing in the whole capsule.

itens: What do you want to be when you grow up?
What do you most like doing?
What do you want to say to yourself when you are grown up?

secoes.titulo: Rules that make the series work
itens: The same questions, in the same order, every year. Changing them breaks the comparison.
Always on the same day, her birthday, so it never depends on a decision.
Do not correct her and do not push. "I don't know" is a great answer and ages very well.
A short video, landscape, always. A minute is enough.
At two, almost nothing will get answered. Record it anyway: it is the first of the series.

secoes.texto: In the capsule, titled "Interview, age X", always the same way. The consistent name is what lets you find them all together and build the sequence later.
